about.heading: About me
paragraphs: I'm Kian (Kaixin) Kang, an undergraduate in Public Art at Sichuan Fine Arts Institute, focused on AI-assisted asset production and technical art tools. I enjoy turning specific production needs into tools artists can use, inspect, and refine.

Since 2023, I've used Stable Diffusion for novel illustrations, character design, and commissioned illustration, building experience in prompt design and style control. That work now extends into 3D: from AI concepts and Tripo modeling to Blender cleanup and validation in UE5 scenes.

From August to October 2026, I worked as a Technical Art / AI Pipeline intern with NetEase Games' ArtSpark team. I contributed to a multimodal AI workflow canvas, ComfyUI image-to-image workflows, and stylized track and asset integration. I also developed Unreal Editor Python orbit-capture tools for 3DGS workflow validation. In my personal projects—MATE, Track Assembly, and Face Value—I explore material control, procedural assembly, and geometry budget planning.

Selected work
Turning art-making needs into repeatable workflows through tools, scenes, and interactive prototypes.WORLDIR scene compilation, material authoring, reference-driven track assembly, AI-assisted modeling, and real-time interaction.
01 / Spatial intelligence · Research and engineering prototype
WORLDIR — World Model Assisted Scene Compiler
Exploring how world-model outputs can become structured, traceable, and editable 3D scenes. Spatial queries, scene compilation, and asset-fitting experiments distinguish observed evidence, unknown regions, and design inference. Selected workflows are implemented; the general architecture remains in development.
World modelsSpatial reconstructionScene GraphPythonBlenderUnreal Engine 5
View project and experiments
02 / Core project · Personal tool prototype
MATE — AI Material Analysis & Procedural Weathering
A desktop material tool I developed to connect multi-view AI analysis, human review, region binding, and an editable effect stack—so surface changes on existing 3D assets remain inspectable, adjustable, and comparable.
ElectronTypeScriptThree.jsAI-assisted workflowsMaterial tools
View project
03 / Tool developmentTrack Assembly Tool
AI analysis turns a reference thumbnail into layout data. Unreal Editor Python, Spline analysis, and HISM then assemble the track assets, with adjustable rules and manual region overrides that keep layout decisions in the artist's hands.
Unreal Engine 5Editor PythonSpline analysisHISMReference-driven assembly
View project
04 / AI-assisted modeling · Two case studiesFace Value & AI Asset Production
Before generation, Face Value analyzes a reference image to propose an explainable triangle budget. After generation, my asset pipeline uses modular breakdown, Blender cleanup, and Unreal Engine validation. Together, the two cases explore what makes AI-generated models usable in real-time prototypes.
Geometry budgetsAI structure analysisAsset pipelinesBlenderUnreal Engine 5
View both case studies
05 / Interactive prototypeAI NPC Interaction Prototype
An Unreal Engine 5 prototype connecting proximity detection, player input modes, a dialogue interface, external API requests, response parsing, and conversation history.
Unreal Engine 5BlueprintsUIAPI integrationInteraction prototyping
View project

about.heading: 关于我
paragraphs: 我是康凯鑫，四川美术学院公共艺术专业本科在读，专注于 AI 辅助资产生产与技术美术工具开发。我希望把美术制作中的具体需求，转化为可以操作、检查和反复调整的工具。
自 2023 年起，我使用 Stable Diffusion 开展小说插画、角色设计与定制插画实践，积累 Prompt 设计和风格控制经验。现在，我将这些探索延伸到三维资产，从 AI 概念生成、Tripo 建模、Blender 拆分优化，一直推进到 UE5 场景验证。
2026 年 8 月至 10 月，我在网易互娱 ArtSpark 实习，方向为技术美术与 AI 管线，参与多模态 AI 工作流画布制作与调试、ComfyUI 图生图流程优化，以及卡通赛道和 AI 资产落地实践；同时开发 UE Editor Python 环绕采集工具，用于 3DGS 流程验证。个人项目中，我通过 MATE、赛道重建工具与面子果实，继续探索材质控制、程序化搭建和几何预算规划。

about.bodyHtml:
我是康凯鑫，四川美术学院公共艺术专业本科在读，专注于 AI 辅助资产生产与技术美术工具开发。我希望把美术制作中的具体需求，转化为可以操作、检查和反复调整的工具。

自 2023 年起，我使用 Stable Diffusion 开展小说插画、角色设计与定制插画实践，积累 Prompt 设计和风格控制经验。现在，我将这些探索延伸到三维资产，从 AI 概念生成、Tripo 建模、Blender 拆分优化，一直推进到 UE5 场景验证。

2026 年 8 月起，我在网易互娱 ArtSpark 实习，方向为技术美术与 AI 管线，参与多模态 AI 工作流画布制作与调试、ComfyUI 图生图流程优化，以及卡通赛道和 AI 资产落地实践；同时开发 UE Editor Python 环绕采集工具，用于 3DGS 流程验证。个人项目中，我通过 MATE、赛道重建工具与面子果实，继续探索材质控制、程序化搭建和几何预算规划。

精选作品
通过工具、场景与交互原型，将美术创意转化为可重复使用的实时制作流程。
项目涵盖 WORLDIR 世界模型场景编译、MATE 材质工具、参考驱动的赛道重建、AI 辅助资产制作与实时交互系统。

01 / 空间智能 · 研究与工程原型
WORLDIR — 世界模型辅助场景编译
探索将世界模型输出转为结构化、可追溯、可编辑的三维场景。围绕空间查询、场景编译与资产拟合开展实验，明确区分观测证据、未知区域与设计推断。部分流程已实现，通用架构持续开发中。
世界模型空间重建Scene GraphPythonBlenderUnreal Engine 5
查看中文项目详情

02 / 核心项目 · 个人工具原型
MATE — AI 材质分析与程序化做旧
我开发的桌面材质工具，将多视角 AI 分析、人工审核、区域绑定与可编辑效果栈连接起来，让已有 3D 资产的表面变化可以继续检查、调整和比较。

03 / 工具开发
赛道重建工具 — Track Assembly Tool
从参考缩略图出发，利用 AI 分析生成布局数据，再通过 Unreal Editor Python、Spline 分析与 HISM 搭建赛道资产。用可调规则与区域手动覆盖，保留美术对布局和排列的控制。
Unreal Engine 5

04 / AI 辅助建模 · 两个案例
面子果实与 AI 资产生产管线
生成前，用“面子果实”分析参考图结构，规划可解释的三角面预算；生成后，通过原有资产管线进行模块化拆分、Blender 修复与 Unreal Engine 验证。两个案例共同探索 AI 建模的制作可用性。
